title: S59 — Audit: receipts doctor — every committed report validated against the schema
desc: GOAL: validate every committed report under reports/ (json/jsonl) with tools/validate_report.py (and friends), and publish one findings table: file, pass/fail, reason, severity. WHY: receipts are the currency — an unverifiable receipt is a liability (S11 retired stale numbers; this is the standing hygiene pass). STEPS: walk reports/ (skip images); run the validator; for files without a validator do shape+count checks and mark 'no validator — proposed minimal checker' as a finding. EVIDENCE: reports/receipts-doctor/<date>.md table + counts + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: no repo edits beyond your report; do not re-run benches; flag, don't fix. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
